summary: Cullinan Therapeutics furnished an 8-K (Items 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) disclosing, together with Taiho Oncology and Taiho Pharmaceutical, topline Phase 3 REZILIENT3 results for zipalertinib plus platinum chemotherapy versus chemotherapy alone in first-line EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC. In 279 randomized patients (140 combination, 139 control), median PFS was 14.5 versus 8.5 months (HR 0.50; 95% CI 0.34-0.73; P=0.00015) at the pre-planned interim analysis after 122 PFS events; ORR 65.0% versus 40.3%. This is a routine clinical-results disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated. Watch for regulatory filing implications and partnering economics, not arbitrage.
